pr_metadata.title: Added support ssl cert file environment

gold_comments.issue_summary:
Can we move this section into the `load_ssl_context_verify()`? Since we're only doing the loading if we've got verify active anyways.

Also is there any harm in having `SSLConfig.verify` default to `True` in the constructor? It defaults to `True` on the client anyways.
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The added block at lines 94–99 in httpx/config.py performs env-based cert loading outside `load_ssl_context_verify()`, contrary to the reviewer's suggestion to move it inside.
gold_comments.rationale: The reviewer explicitly asked to move the `trust_env` logic into `load_ssl_context_verify()` to consolidate verification-related loading; keeping it separate reduces cohesion and may obscure the relationship between env-based cert loading and verification.
